Young athletes set records in swimming and Rubik's Cube

A 13-year-old Chinese swimmer set a new Asian Games record in the 200m medley, winning a gold medal. Separately, a six-year-old Chinese girl broke the women's Rubik's Cube world record with a 4.27-second average.
